package migrated

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http/pagination"
)

func inline() []http.Registration {
	return []http.Registration{
		http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read))).Handle(handler),
		http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer))).Handle(handler),
		http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AnyOf(http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer)), http.AllOf(http.Permissions(editor)))).Handle(handler),
		http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer)), http.ActorMiddleware[User](audit)).Handle(handler),
		http.Authenticated[Reply, User](endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read))).Handle(handler),
		http.RequireAuthentication(endpoint, auth, guard, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(write))).Handle(handler),
		http.RequireRouteAuthentication(route, auth, guard, http.AllOf(http.Permissions(editor))).Handle(handler),
		http.TicketAuthenticated(endpoint, users, redeemer, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer))).Handle(handler),
	}
}

func paged() {
	var page pagination.PageEndpoint
	_ = pagination.Authenticated(page, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)))
}

func multiline() {
	_ = http.Authenticated(endpoint, users,
		http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(
			viewer,
		)),
	)
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint,
		users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read)),
	)
	_ = e
}
